source.name: Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 on clinical trials on medicinal products for human use
source.note: Binding in all EU Member States. Repeals Directive 2001/20/EC.

mappings.title: General rules on protection of subjects
mappings.note: Subject-protection duties map across CRC, PI and RA.

mappings.title: Informed consent
mappings.note: Strong across four tracks.

mappings.title: Informed consent in cluster trials
mappings.note: NO COUNTERPART. Cluster-randomised trials and their simplified consent route are absent from CRLN.

mappings.title: Clinical trials on incapacitated subjects
mappings.note: NO COUNTERPART. Consent by legal representative for incapacitated adults is absent.

mappings.title: Clinical trials on minors
mappings.note: NO COUNTERPART. Assent, paediatric consent and the minor's wishes are absent from every track, including RN.

mappings.title: Clinical trials on pregnant or breastfeeding women
mappings.note: NO COUNTERPART. No competency addresses this population.

mappings.title: Clinical trials in emergency situations
mappings.note: NO COUNTERPART. Deferred and emergency consent is absent, and it is the hardest consent situation a coordinator meets.

mappings.title: Notification of start of trial and end of recruitment
mappings.note: CRLN covers start-up operationally but not the CTR's specific notification duties and clocks.

mappings.title: End, temporary halt and early termination
mappings.note: CRLN has no close-out or early-termination competency as such.

mappings.title: Temporary halt or early termination for subject safety
mappings.note: Escalation is covered; the sponsor's halt decision and its notification clock are not.

mappings.title: Reporting of adverse events and SAEs by the investigator
mappings.note: Strong across CRC, PI, RN and ASSIST.

mappings.title: Reporting of SUSARs by the sponsor
mappings.note: Strong via the PV track.

mappings.title: Annual reporting by the sponsor to the Agency
mappings.note: CRLN covers periodic reporting generically, not the CTR's annual safety report to EMA.

mappings.title: Reporting with regard to auxiliary medicinal products
mappings.note: NO COUNTERPART. 'Auxiliary medicinal product' is an EU CTR concept with no CRLN equivalent.

mappings.title: Compliance with the protocol and good clinical practice
mappings.note: Strong. This is the CTR's GCP-compliance article.

mappings.title: Monitoring
mappings.note: Strong via the CRA track.

mappings.title: Suitability of individuals involved in conducting the clinical trial
crln_labels: Knowing the Limit of Your Own Authority
mappings.note: THE ARTICLE THIS FRAMEWORK EXISTS TO SERVE. Art 49 requires that individuals be qualified by education, training and experience, and like ICH E6 does not define it measurably. That undefined requirement is CRLN-TRG-001's entire reason for existing, and until now the framework never cited it.

mappings.title: Suitability of clinical trial sites
mappings.note: Maps to the CRA feasibility competency.

mappings.title: Traceability, storage, return and destruction of IMPs
mappings.note: Strong across PHARM, CRC and CRA.

mappings.title: Reporting of serious breaches
mappings.note: CRLN covers deviations, but 'serious breach' is a defined EU CTR concept with a seven-day notification clock that CRLN does not teach or assess.

mappings.title: Other reporting obligations relevant for subject safety
mappings.note: Generic escalation only.

mappings.title: Urgent safety measures
mappings.note: CRLN covers escalation but not the specific urgent-safety-measure duty and its notification.

mappings.title: Investigator's brochure
mappings.note: NO COUNTERPART. No competency addresses maintaining or using the IB, though ICH E6 Appendix A is cited elsewhere.

mappings.title: Recording, processing, handling and storage of information
mappings.note: Strong, though CRLN frames it via 21 CFR Part 11 rather than the CTR.

mappings.title: Clinical trial master file
mappings.note: Strong via the CTA track.

mappings.title: Archiving of the clinical trial master file
mappings.note: CRLN covers TMF management; the CTR's 25-year archiving duty is not assessed.

mappings.title: Responsibilities of the qualified person
mappings.note: NO COUNTERPART. The Qualified Person is an EU statutory role with no CRLN track. This is a structural gap for EU operations.

mappings.title: Unauthorised IMPs and auxiliary medicinal products: labelling
mappings.note: CRLN cites EU GMP Annex 13 once; CTR Annex VI labelling is not assessed.

mappings.title: Sponsor
mappings.note: CRLN assesses individuals, not the sponsor entity, so this maps only where a person discharges it.

mappings.title: Principal investigator
mappings.note: Strong via the PI track.

mappings.title: Damage compensation
mappings.note: NO COUNTERPART. Insurance and indemnity are absent from CRLN, as they were from the TDR crosswalk.

mappings.title: Data protection
mappings.note: One statement on one track. The CTR points at GDPR, which CRLN cites once across 84 statements.
